capabilities: Insert new dates and date-times via a date picker
Edit existing date and time values with commands or automatic picker
Add calendar buttons to date and time values in notes
Select previous or next date and time with commands
Automatically select date/time text for quick formatting
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pick or edit date and time values in notes without typing them manually.
summary: Date picker plugin that inserts and edits dates and times anywhere in Markdown notes via a calendar widget.
